messages.spin: data {rpm}: the disc's spin, 0 to 60 turns a minute (0 stops it where it is). Replies {rotation, spin, scale, taps}.
messages.rotation: data {deg}: turns the disc to deg, 0 to 359, spinning or not. Replies {rotation, spin, scale, taps}.
messages.scale: data {pct}: the disc's scale, 10 to 400 percent (100: 400 px). Replies {rotation, spin, scale, taps}.
messages.state: Change nothing. Replies {rotation, spin, scale, taps}: what get says, and the taps so far.
